description: Dataset of cycling-specific infrastructure in Switzerland (1998-2024) is a data set deposited in ETH Zürich Research Collection by its authors Sebastiano Papini, David Zani. The dataset contains 616,948 georeferenced instances of cycling-specific infrastructure features across 10 major Swiss agglomerations (Basel, Bern, Biel, Geneva, Lausanne, Lugano, Lucerne, St. Gallen, Winterthur, Zurich), extracted from aerial imagery (SWISSIMAGE) between 1998 and 2023. Model and codebase available: https://gitlab.ethz.ch/spapini/remote_velo_public Each record includes: instance_id: Unique identifier for each detected object. Coverage: national (CH); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. Formats: GeoPackage. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is http://rightsstatements.org/page/InC-NC/1.0/. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
